units.source_text: 女子一把攥住他的指头，没有松开，手牵手地登上楼去。

en.t: The woman seized his fingers and, without letting go, went upstairs hand in hand with him.

units.source_text: 在被炉［日本的取暖设备。在炭炉上放个木架，罩上棉被而成］前，

en.t: In front of the kotatsu, a Japanese heater made by setting a wooden frame over a charcoal brazier and covering it with a quilt,

units.source_text: 她把他的手松开时，一下子连脖子根都涨红了。

en.t: When she let go of his hand, she suddenly flushed red all the way to the base of her neck.

units.source_text: 为了掩饰这点，她慌慌张张地又抓住了他的手说：

en.t: To cover this up, she hurriedly took his hand again and said:
